_about: Public seed list for the term-harvest skill, for Grokbot to run through the term engine (Torian 2026-11-01 02:49Z). Grok is an untrusted proposer: it drafts senses and facts; only the engine and Lean admit a term. Nothing private belongs here: no founder glossary, no Mentura research engine terms. Entries with outside_models false (the research areas, from Mentura's research engine) stay with Claude and the kernel; filter them out before handing the list to Grokbot.
how: For each pending term: list its standard senses with a source each (standards first, EE-014), plus ours if we use it differently.
Pick the level its records live at and the facts (booleans) that tell its senses apart; reuse a level file from naive-design/prototypes/architecture/*-vocab.ts when one fits.
Write each sense as necessary properties, add predicts against its neighbours, and run it exhaustively. A refuted prediction is a finding: report it, never tune it away silently.
Mirror each confirmed relation in Lean and check it.
Add a usage note (use, avoid, instead) to usage.json.
Order by the relevance rule High = Load and (Salient or Contested); run contested terms (collides_with not empty) first.
